subject: Electrical Engineering
title: Motor Drives in Electric Vehicles
description: A quick win: understand Motor Drives in Electric Vehicles.

hook.text: An EV's motor delivers maximum torque from zero RPM — no gearbox, no clutch.

buildup.text: An inverter converts battery DC into three-phase AC at precisely controlled frequency.

discovery.text: Field-oriented control adjusts torque and speed independently — smooth as a conveyor belt.

twist.text: Some EVs use two motors — one per axle — for all-wheel drive and torque vectoring.

climax.text: The Rimac Nevera uses four motors — one per wheel — producing 1,914 horsepower total.

punchline.text: Electric motors made transmissions optional and instant torque the new standard.

quiz.question: Why don't most electric vehicles need a multi-speed transmission?
options: Electric motors are too weak to benefit from gear ratios
Electric motors deliver high torque from zero RPM across a wide speed range
Transmissions are incompatible with regenerative braking systems
